title: Case: Customer asks when the replacement for a split bookcase will ship
context: A delivered bookcase has a split side panel. Saltmarrow Goods decides replacements; the desk has already relayed one decision to the customer.
initial_request: Any news on when the new one ships?? Also bin men come tomorrow morning so I've flattened the box and put it out with the broken panel, hope thats ok

events.body: Damage report DMG-9364 opened for TG-8183 (bookcase, delivered as DL-8120 on 2027-03-30). Customer sent two photos showing a split along the left side panel. Passed to Replacement authorisations.
The bookcase turned up with the side split right down. Can't build it. I'd like another one sent, not a refund.
My parcel DL-58149 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
For DMG-9364 on TG-8183: the customer reports the left side panel split on arrival and asks for a replacement rather than a refund. Please decide and let me know what I can tell him.
DL-77216 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Route plan for depot HL-6 published for Monday. 43 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Replacement approved for TG-8183 under DMG-9364. Dispatch date to follow from the warehouse.

Thanks,
Aurelio
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
Saltmarrow's Replacement authorisations team has approved a replacement under DMG-9364. They have not given a dispatch date yet; I'll pass it on when they do.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Great thanks. What do I do with the broken one, it's taking up the whole hallway
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Wednesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

Correction on TG-8183. The approval sent at 10:10 was issued in error and is withdrawn. Both photos show the panel only, and the carton behind it looks undamaged, so this goes to inspection before any decision. No replacement has been released to the warehouse. We need from the customer: (1) photos of the outer carton, all sides, (2) a photo of the carton label, (3) the item and all packaging kept as received until inspection is finished. Damage intake will take the photos on DMG-9364 through the order thread. The decision follows inspection; we are not indicating which way it will go.
Any news on when the new one ships?? Also bin men come tomorrow morning so I've flattened the box and put it out with the broken panel, hope thats ok

acceptable_actions.summary: Tell Nerys the replacement approval has been withdrawn pending inspection, no replacement is on its way, and ask him to keep the item and all packaging and send the carton and label photos through the thread.

must: States that Saltmarrow has withdrawn the replacement approval and the case is going to inspection, with no decision yet.
Asks Nerys to keep the bookcase and all packaging, including the carton and panel he has put out for collection.
Asks for photos of the outer carton (all sides) and the carton label through the order thread.
must_not: Give a dispatch date for a replacement or say one is on its way.
Say the replacement is approved, or let the earlier approval stand uncorrected.
Say it is fine to throw away the carton or the damaged panel.
Promise a replacement, refund or compensation, or predict the inspection result.
Suggest the customer caused the damage or is being dishonest.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: I have to correct what I told you this morning. Saltmarrow's Replacement authorisations team has withdrawn the approval they sent at 10:10; they say it was issued in error, and the case now goes to inspection before they decide. No replacement has been released, so there is no ship date, and they have not said which way the decision will go. Please bring the carton and the broken panel back in before the bin collection: they need the bookcase and all its packaging kept as received until the inspection is finished. They also need photos of the outer carton from all sides (flattened is better than nothing) and a photo of the carton label, sent in this thread under DMG-9364. I'm sorry for the reversal.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-505: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
